notes: 1916 four-storey flats at the O'Farrell corner: buff glazed brick upper storeys with iron balcony fire escapes, a dark slate-grey tiled base under a banded cornice. Ground: a wide lattice shop window at the corner end, five small sash windows, a garage door at the right end. Plain, no ornament invented. Buff glazed brick drawn as buff stucco (brick kit renders red under a buff tint). Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Cream/buff brick upper wall, dark blue-black glazed-tile base to the belt, large multi-pane barred window left, bronze belt cornice over the base (hand.py). Fire escapes: the two columns (left and right), not 3-4, so no column added. Lifted/converted once to #ffffff. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #323b46 -> #515862 (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
